page.layout: One page of running text with a chapter heading and a woodcut in the text block. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the first lines of the opening paragraph.

p.i: bentes voracium instar pecudum Epicuri què de grege porcorum vino ciboq, adeo se obruunt at- que infarciunt, vt omnem mentis rationisque vsum amittant, irapiis nefariisque contra De- VM & Proximum patris foederibus, se obstrin- gant atque deuinciant, unde maxima mala at- que calamitates necessario enascuntur. Verum sat commessatum est, sat prolixe coenatum; adeo pulluciibiles coenas conuiuiaque varia va- rio ferculorum apparatu exhibuit unicum illud ocymum, ex eoq, puls: saliuam si forsan alicui mouerim, cà se saturet, vlteriore enim & lau- tiore ferculo palatum explere non valeo. Et ba- lenus de frumentis eorumque variis differen- tiis, sequuntur nunc panificia, pultes, placenta & libamina, quae ex iis conficiuntur.

main_text.head: CAP. VII. Depane, placentis, pultibus, va-riifq; eduliis.
main_text.p: X frugibus hactenus com-memoratis fiunt panificia. Inter omnia enim alimenta primas tenet panis, esculen-torum potulentorumque fir-missimum & probatissimum vinculum.

page.notes: The opening marginal note is set in six short lines ("Getma-" / "norum" / "bibacitas" / "in conui" / "mistaxa-" / "tur,"); the word after "conui" is not clearly legible, so it is marked [?]. The chapter heading and its title are set on two lines and are joined as one head. A woodcut initial "X" with a small illustration of a figure stands beside the first paragraph after the heading; it is not text. The word "va-riifq;" is hyphenated at the line end and kept as printed; the reading "riifq;" is taken as printed. The first paragraph is in italic type throughout. The final paragraph is set with a large initial X and no other special marks.
